lines: This supreme truth, own-nature shining as
manifestation-form, is taken by itself from
autonomy; by the order — thrown off, turned to
expansion, expanding, expanded — it shines; and
shining too is the Lord's own nature — so here
the yoga-limbs are not the direct means.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ayaṃ paramārthaḥ svarūpaṃ prakāśamānam akhyātirūpatvaṃ svayaṃ svātantryāt gṛhītaṃ krameṇa projjhya vikāsonmukham atha vikasat atha vikasitam ity anena krameṇa prakāśate tathā prakāśanam api parameśvarasya svarūpam eva tasmāt na atra yogāṅgāni sākṣāt upāyaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does paramārtha shine, and what follows for yoga-limbs? → The shining-order (projjhya-vikāsa) is svarūpa itself; limbs mediate but do not cause it.
c1_essence: Paramārtha shines by the order thrown-off→expansion→expanded from svātantrya; shining is svarūpa — limbs not direct means.
reads_against.c1_rasa: karuṇā with vīrya weight (compassion carrying fierce argument)
